the receipt follows the read-back, not the save > a conflict from another window says so on the receipt; a save that THROWS reads as not saved
the receipt follows the read-back, not the save > a save slower than the deadline > a late success settles the same receipt: Undo, no note, and one saved row

the receipt follows the read-back, not the save > a save slower than the deadline > AUDIT L2: a late answer is not read as a step of a request started meanwhile

the receipt follows the read-back, not the save > a save slower than the deadline > the in-flight mark stays while the save is out

the receipt follows the read-back, not the save > a failure after the save still clears Saving: the receipt is never left on it
the receipt follows the read-back, not the save > the lock holds: a second message while the save is out is not run
the receipt follows the read-back, not the save > the in-flight mark stays until the save answers

served vs dark > served short.list alone: only stock.shortList is registered, once, and it unregisters cleanly
served vs dark > both served: local-only on BOTH sides, never a plain data read, inside the manifest text limits
served vs dark > each answer makes ONE read of its own kind, with the member's arguments (a rank word read by the panel's map)
served vs dark > no read without a turn or without a usable argument, and a refusal is answered in fixed words
routing words > the group is words-only and never a filler, routing.js lists the two by action with no word of its own, and it is the 47th group under the cap
routing words > dark (null, data off): the group has no words, and the data and screener groups keep exactly routing.js's
routing words > dark ([], nothing activated): the group has no words, and the data and screener groups keep exactly routing.js's
routing words > dark (["quote","themes","earnings","earnings.season","group.drill"], other kinds only): the group has no words, and the data and screener groups keep exactly routing.js's
routing words > served interest alone: only its own words are armed, no other group's words change, and they are taken back
routing words > served list alone: only its own words are armed, no other group's words change, and they are taken back
routing words > every capability has words, and each ask is named by its own capability's words and by no other of this wave
routing words > served: each ask routes its capability under v1 and v2, and the budget never cuts the group
routing words > served: the words never name another capability's language, and v1 does not send the group for it either
routing words > the nearest neighbours keep their own asks: the Screener's short float, the confluence board's bearish side, a bare "short"
routing words > served: the fill for a message nothing recognised never carries the words-only group
routing words > the typo lexicon: registering the two changes no correction of any OTHER capability's capreg corpus phrasing
routing words > no OTHER capability's capreg corpus phrasing is named by these words (armed, the group rides with none of them)
routing words > the earlier waves' words name none of this wave's asks, and these words name none of theirs
routing words > no row of the routing-collision table is named by these words (every row belongs to another group)

UPPER BOUND ON runtime:expression-statement — 266 scripts ⭐ a STRICT upper bound: every line this guard refuses is DELETED, which is more permissive than any correct implementation can be.
scripts it refuses at all : 1 build BEFORE : 23 build AFTER (perfect, at best) : 23 GAIN, AT BEST : 0
⛔ ZERO. Solving this guard perfectly moves the build count by nothing ON THE FIRST-BLOCKER PATH. A guard whose refused lines are BINDINGS can still gain: deleting a binding breaks its consumers, so the peel is stricter than an implementation. Measured once, +1 forecast -> +2 real. That is not a reason to skip it — it may still be a correctness fix — but it IS a reason not to expect movement, and to say so up front.

L3 · destructive / permanent changes still need approval > the approval policy is a deliberate list: every confirm-risk or permanent action is proposed; only indicator.saveDraft may skip its card on the member's own words

stock.yearlyHighsLows — the answer > a session under way: the counts, the names by the H52 panel's own order, and the snapshot's own time
stock.yearlyHighsLows — the answer > no vendor stamp: UCT's own time, labelled as such; an old read is said to be stale
stock.yearlyHighsLows — the answer > a finished session (finished) is named as one, with why, dated by its close
stock.yearlyHighsLows — the answer > a finished session (thin) is named as one, with why, dated by its close
stock.yearlyHighsLows — the answer > a finished session (closed) is named as one, with why, dated by its close
stock.yearlyHighsLows — the answer > a finished session (no_read) is named as one, with why, dated by its close
stock.yearlyHighsLows — the answer > a stored session that is behind is stale; one side only when one was asked for
stock.yearlyHighsLows — the answer > a list that could not be read is never "no new lows"; an empty list is a count of zero
stock.yearlyHighsLows — the answer > refused / unavailable: fixed words keyed on the status, no figure, no table
stock.yearlyHighsLows — the answer > the sides and the lists are the kind's own and the H52 panel's own (read from both files, never retyped)
stock.themeRotation — the answer > each theme's whole ranks, a change that matches them, and UCT's own working time
stock.themeRotation — the answer > one side only, and no theme rotating is a healthy answer
stock.themeRotation — the answer > not held on the server / refused: never "nothing is rotating"
stock.themeRotation — the answer > the sides and the limit are the kind's own (read from the adapter, never retyped)
stock.confluenceBoard — the answer > the board in the server's order, the long-dated share turned into a percent once, and UCT's build time
stock.confluenceBoard — the answer > a direction asked for, a stale board, a missing leg and an unknown build time are each said
stock.confluenceBoard — the answer > nothing on the board is a normal answer; a board still building is never that
stock.confluenceBoard — the answer > the directions and the limit are the kind's own (read from the adapter, never retyped)
stock.expectedMove — the answer > the straddle the server holds, its break-evens, the expiry it runs to, and UCT's own read time
stock.expectedMove — the answer > an expiry on the report day, no report date, and a last good read are each said
stock.expectedMove — the answer > no straddle held: no price is stated, only what was stored; nothing held at all is never "no move is priced"
stock.callSearch — the answer > one line per call with the index's own excerpt, never longer and never as HTML
stock.callSearch — the answer > a search within one stock, a widened search and a total wider than the hits are each said
stock.callSearch — the answer > no hit is a finding about the calls the index holds; an empty index or a failed search is never "no mention"
stock.callSearch — the answer > the query and row limits are the kind's own (read from the adapter, never retyped)

the drain’s settles > …and the reverse: a record stamped 1 re-queued after an entry stamped 0 keeps 1 (no over-refusal from the entry)
the drain’s settles > settleBlocked, with no record to keep, rebuilds one carrying the ENTRY’s stamp
recovery — the stamp travels with the copy that wins > the durable record alone: its stamp (and none ⇒ none, read as 0 at send)
recovery — the stamp travels with the copy that wins > the crash draft alone: its stamp
recovery — the stamp travels with the copy that wins > a draft AHEAD of the record wins with the DRAFT’s stamp
recovery — the stamp travels with the copy that wins > ⛔ two copies that AGREE ⇒ the LOWER stamp, whichever is listed first
recovery — the stamp travels with the copy that wins > ⛔ adoption carries the LOWER of the record’s and the entry’s stamps
Charts puts the results on the grid, in list order, and back to List restores the list
Next turns the page onto the next results; Prev turns back
the charts-per-page choice is kept, and the view reopens as Charts
the layout menu is the /charts Multi Chart menu: every preset, Custom N×M and the sync toggles, nothing that would replace the results
the sync toggles are kept for the next visit
a member who left on Charts lands on Charts
Map draws the results grouped by sector; a tile opens that stock on the List
the grouping choice is kept; Theme groups by the batched theme read
the controls row shows only on a screen whose starter declares controls
choosing an option edits exactly its clause in the scan, and the Filters count and (edited) mark follow
an option with a sort sets the sort, second key included; the URL keeps it across a refresh
Reset restores the starter spec exactly and forgets the remembered choices of that screen only
a choice is remembered: the preference is written per screen and per control
opening a screen fresh re-applies the remembered choices in ONE scan, shown as the edit they are
a first open that lands on a pinned RS screen applies the remembered choices too
a last-used screen lands at once from this browser, and takes the remembered choices when both reads answer
a member who has already touched the page keeps the screen they landed on
a URL that already carries an edited spec is never overridden by remembered choices
a re-sort from the Sort menu makes Rank by read Custom on the page, with the dot and Reset
back or forward to a spec no starter was made of by its controls alone is a custom screen, without the row
a saved copy of an RS screen is the member's own screen: no quick controls
Top RS Rating has two controls: one inline plus Adjust
List mode never loads ScannerShell; Table mode loads it on demand
only range columns the screen REQUIRES are probed; an any-of alternative is not
a presence probe matches exactly the rows that hold a value
a zero caused by a live-only column with no value yet is "live during the session"
in the session the same zero is an ordinary zero
until every probe answers the reason is unknown, never a guess
Gap Movers after the close is a real zero: its live column is only one alternative
a non-live column nobody holds is "not available yet"
a coverage receipt where no row could be checked is "not available yet"
1. tapping row 2 opens a full-screen dialog named for that stock, with its chart pane
2. Next stock steps to row 3 (pane and list), Previous stock steps back

alert.create > the current price is ONE `quotes` gateway read for the turn; dark → no read, no refusal, the proposal says it was not checked
alert.create > VALID: proposed (never auto-applied); Apply POSTs exactly that alert, reads it back; Undo deletes exactly it
alert.create > UNDO is refused once the alert went off (deleting it would not unsend the notification)

alert.create > UNSUPPORTED condition (not above/below) is refused by the closed schema
alert.create > LIMIT: at most 5 alerts in one request; the same alert twice in one request is refused
alert.create > a DUPLICATE made elsewhere between proposal and Apply is refused at the write (server re-read)
alert.create > PERSISTENCE FAILURE: the server refuses → the receipt says so, nothing is claimed, nothing left behind
alert.create > PARTIAL FAILURE mid-request: the alert already made is taken back
alert.delete > by stable id: proposed; Apply deletes exactly that row and reads back; NO Undo (hard delete)
alert.delete > STALE: the alert went off (or was deleted elsewhere) after the proposal → refused, nothing deleted
alert.delete > an alert that is not in the member's book cannot be targeted

stock.riskProfile — the answer > volatility, beta, returns, its own declines and the corrections line, each as the server worked it out, with the data's own date
stock.riskProfile — the answer > a statistic too short is words never 0, a corrections block not held is said, a stale answer is said and never worked out again
stock.riskProfile — the answer > not held, refused, an unclean answer and a missing ticker are never "no statistics"
stock.riskProfile — the answer > the limits and every field the answer reads are the kind's own (read from the adapter)
stock.volumeFootprint — the answer > the 25 and 50 session counts, up/down volume, pocket pivots and gaps with their fill shares, each the server's own
stock.volumeFootprint — the answer > not held, refused and an unclean answer are never "no accumulation"
stock.volumeFootprint — the answer > the limits and every field the answer reads are the kind's own (read from the adapter)
stock.factorExposure — the answer > the server's reading, each loading with its t and whether it clears the bar, R-squared and the VIF warning
stock.factorExposure — the answer > a window not fitted states no loading and no reading, never 0
stock.factorExposure — the answer > not held, refused and an unclean answer are never "no exposure"
stock.factorExposure — the answer > every field the answer reads is the kind's own (read from the adapter), and the factors are the service's
stock.setupHistory — the answer > the newest signals of each setup with their phase and returns, and the universe line per setup and phase
stock.setupHistory — the answer > a universe not held, no phases and no signal at all are each said
stock.setupHistory — the answer > not held, refused and an unclean answer are never "no signal"
stock.setupHistory — the answer > the limits and every field the answer reads are the kind's own (read from the adapter)
the price studies — stale words > an earlier session's answer and closes that stop short are said in each price study, with its own panel code, never worked out again
stock.companyRecord — the answer > each section with its state, headline figure, matched names and its agency's own required words; a section not held is said
stock.companyRecord — the answer > nothing held, refused and an unclean answer are never "no records"
stock.companyRecord — the answer > the limits, the sections, the credits and every field the answer reads are the kind's own (read from the adapter)
stock.ownershipReport — the answer > how many funds hold it and what changed, the largest holders with their change, the coverage and the data set
stock.ownershipReport — the answer > a stock no fund holding could be matched to is never "no fund holds it"; a change not comparable is neither added nor cut
stock.ownershipReport — the answer > not read yet, refused and an unclean answer are never "no fund holds it"
stock.ownershipReport — the answer > the limits, the states and every field the answer reads are the kind's own (read from the adapter)
served vs dark > the six kinds and the six capabilities, by name

NLM-1 two-key gate — anything but BOTH keys on is v1, byte-identical > server off: browser unset / on → v1, same fingerprint through the chooser useAgent calls
NLM-1 two-key gate — anything but BOTH keys on is v1, byte-identical > server on: browser kill switch "0" → v1, same fingerprint; browser unset → v2 (default on)
NLM-1 two-key gate — anything but BOTH keys on is v1, byte-identical > both on → routing v2 (which does route differently)

testcase.name: matchName > exact (normalized), one clear typo, a tie, nothing
matchName > short words and numbers are exact only; strict allows one edit on 5+ letter words
layouts > a typo in a layout name opens it (instant); a model-planned typo resolves the same way
layouts > a tie is ASKED with the real names, never guessed
layouts > nothing close → no guess (the check refuses / the model decides); exact names and "previous" still win
layouts > HIGH-IMPACT rename / copy: strict (one edit, 5+ letters) and still a proposal naming the real layout
layouts > a protected layout reached through a typo is still protected
watchlists > safe actions take one clear typo match: add, open, show, remove
watchlists > rename is strict; a tie or nothing close → no instant action
watchlists > deleting a list has no instant phrase at all: always the model, always a proposal
saved screens and templates > running a saved screen (read-only) takes one clear typo match
saved screens and templates > a template (replaces indicators: high impact) is never applied on a guess — “Did you mean …?”

an Agent indicator change is saved as committed — never a change behind > 1–5 · add, colour, Undo colour, Undo add, again: after EVERY receipt the server holds exactly what the chart shows
an Agent indicator change is saved as committed — never a change behind > 6 · an Agent change, then the member's own chart change: both saved, the newer last
an Agent indicator change is saved as committed — never a change behind > 7 · the member edits while the Agent is mid-change: no older write lands after a newer one
an Agent indicator change is saved as committed — never a change behind > 8 · reload after a completed change: the latest confirmed state is what loads
an Agent indicator change is saved as committed — never a change behind > a save the server refuses: the member is told it is not saved — never a success receipt
INV2 panel > P1: instant "make the rsi pane bigger", save refused (409) → put back and said so; no Undo; the next edit is refused up front
INV2 panel > P2: move (saves) + resize (409) + recolor → the resize is put back and the loop STOPS; the recolor never runs
INV2 panel > P2b: the middle step stays ON SCREEN unsaved (the member edited during a slow save) → never "didn't do"; the loop stops
INV2 panel > R3: an earlier saved change, then a failed one (one 409, put back) → "undo" takes back the earlier change
F5 — chart.compare holds the product ceiling (chartCeilings.MAX_COMPARISONS) > a sixth comparison is refused, with the real number
F5 — chart.compare holds the product ceiling (chartCeilings.MAX_COMPARISONS) > swapping one for another at the ceiling is counted on the RESULT, and runs
F5 — chart.compare holds the product ceiling (chartCeilings.MAX_COMPARISONS) > a chart already past the ceiling (the Compare panel allows it) can still REMOVE
F5 — chart.compare holds the product ceiling (chartCeilings.MAX_COMPARISONS) > removing a symbol that is not compared says so — never "already there"
F6 — chart.goToDate is honest about its Undo > a known earlier view: Undo scrolls back; once the member scrolls, Undo is stale and refuses
